group: Valid section – empty list (null) → record not found

cases.description: The requested section exists but its internal list is null (no records have been added). The method should return false.

group: Valid section – non‑null list without the record → false

cases.description: The section contains a list of records, but the list does not contain the supplied record. The method should return false.

group: Valid section – list contains the record → true

cases.description: The section contains a non‑null list and the supplied record is present in that list. The method should return true.

group: Valid section – null record argument → false

cases.description: A null record is passed. The section list is non‑null but does not contain null, so the method should return false (no exception is thrown).
Section.check should reject a negative section index and throw IllegalArgumentException.
Section.check should reject a section index larger than the maximum allowed value and throw IllegalArgumentException.
The requested section has been initialised with an empty ArrayList (size 0). No records are stored, so the method must return false.

group: Record present in a different section → false

cases.description: A record that exists in the ANSWER section is queried against the AUTHORITY section. The method should only look at the supplied section and therefore return false.

group: Different instance with identical fields → true

cases.description: A record equal to one already stored in the ADDITIONAL section is created as a new object. Because Record.equals compares the logical fields, findRecord must return true.

group: Null record with null list → false

cases.description: Both the supplied record and the internal list for the QUESTION section are null. The method should safely return false without throwing an exception.
The ANSWER section holds the same record twice (duplicate entries). List.contains returns true as soon as it finds a match, so findRecord must return true.

group: Same name/type but different data → false

cases.description: A record with the same owner name and type as one stored in AUTHORITY exists, but its address differs. Because Record.equals includes the rdata, findRecord must return false.
The Message object's internal `sections` field is deliberately set to null (e.g., via reflection) before invoking findRecord. Accessing `sections[section]` triggers a NullPointerException.
